_public_note: Public build manifest. Verbatim retail source strings are stored as SHA-256 digests (fields ending in _sha256); the builder recomputes them from the user's own ROM. Japanese text in this file is written by this project.
_note: Editorial decision of record for the third class 5 batch: the 164 US-only fx_text entries that have no JP original anywhere. Consumed and revalidated on every build by ffta_jp_us_only_fx_text.py. Markup: {HEX} is a CTR_FUNC operand, {EOS} is a CTR_EOS separator, every other character is text. [ and ] are literal characters, which is why controls use braces.

terminology.judge: control 0x5117; the JP originals write [5117]ポイント for judge points (fx_text/17/86, /121, /211), so the bonus laws read [5117]ポイントボーナス
terminology.JP (abbreviation): written literally as JP, attested in fx_text/16/13 (全JPを消費します)
terminology.dark element: 暗黒, never 闇 — the JP attribute label, attested at fx_text/21/27 (属性:暗黒)
terminology.law / antilaw: ロウ / アンチロウ, and うち消す for nullifying, per JP fx_text/23
terminology.law text shape: the JP penalty law of the same content is the layout and wording authority; the bonus variant replaces ペナルティ with [5117]ポイントボーナス
terminology.weapon classes: 杖 / ロッド / メイス / 弓·剛弓·銃 etc., taken from the JP 分類: lines in fx_text/21 and the JP weapon laws in fx_text/23
terminology.named speakers: [510A] エゼル, [5109] バブス, [5104] リッツ, [510C] シャラ, [5106] シド — identified from JP s_text, and each block keeps that character's register

width_policy.rule: per-leaf bound = the widest single rendered line among that leaf's own JP originals, measured with the JP font advance metadata
width_policy.width_reference_reason: fx_text leaf 10 holds only three short JP treasure lines, which do not bound the box: its US-only entries are the lesson-mode duplicates of the leaf 1 system prompts, and the US original at fx_text/10/3 is itself 136px wide, above leaf 10's own JP maximum of 133. Leaf 1's JP originals are the correct reference for that message family.
width_policy.lines_per_page: also bounded by the same leaf's JP maximum lines per page

control_policy.preserved: every CTR_FUNC operand of the US original that is not a layout control — name and mission references, the yes/no selector, the CTR_EOS selector separators — reappears in the Japanese, and the trailing close sequence (0x40 / 0x56 / 0x42) is identical
control_policy.dropped: English typesetting only: word space 0x52 and the justification controls 0x1D02 / 0x1D03 / 0x1D04 / 0x1B01, which carry no meaning in Japanese
control_policy.relaid_out: line 0x4D and page 0x4F breaks are re-flowed to Japanese line lengths, following the JP original of the same message
